name: Mapbox
description: Mapbox skills and MCP servers for building location-aware applications with AI. Includes geospatial tools, style management, and patterns for web, iOS, Android, and AI agent frameworks.
longDescription:
Ships **20 skills** and **3 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (20): `mapbox-android-patterns` (Official integration patterns for Mapbox Maps SDK on Android), `mapbox-cartography` (Expert guidance on map design principles, color theory, visual hierarchy, typography, and cartographic best practices for creating effective…), `mapbox-data-visualization-patterns` (Patterns for visualizing data on maps including choropleth maps, heat maps, 3D visualizations, data-driven styling, and animated data), `mapbox-flutter-patterns` (Official integration patterns for the Mapbox Maps Flutter SDK), `mapbox-geospatial-operations` (Expert guidance on choosing the right geospatial tool based on problem type, accuracy requirements, and performance needs), `mapbox-google-maps-migration` (Migration guide for developers moving from Google Maps Platform to Mapbox GL JS, covering API equivalents, pattern translations,…), `mapbox-ios-patterns` (Official integration patterns for Mapbox Maps SDK on iOS), `mapbox-location-grounding` (Compose Mapbox MCP tools to produce grounded, cited location-aware responses from live data instead of training data), and 12 more
- **MCP servers** (3): `mapbox-devkit`, `mapbox`, `mapbox-docs`

Installs with `claude plugin install mapbox@claude-plugins-official` from `mapbox/mapbox-agent-skills`.
